question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state institutions underpins the 96% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Loyal personnel appointments and recent military leadership changes have further centralized authority without evident factional challenges or elite realignment ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Ongoing public engagements, diplomatic activity through mid-2026, and policy continuity on economic planning and technological priorities show no disruption in his leadership role. Historical patterns tie major transitions to scheduled congresses rather than abrupt exits. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an unforeseen health event, sharp economic downturn prompting internal reevaluation, or external crisis eroding elite cohesion before the end of 2026.
